items.title: Strategy's Record-Breaking Bitcoin Accumulation
points: Strategy's Bitcoin holdings reached a record 848,000 BTC after acquiring 334 BTC for $29 million last week
The firm posted a $21 billion third-quarter fair-value gain (mark-to-market unrealized gain reflecting current Bitcoin price), including $1.88 billion in deferred tax obligations not yet paid
Strategy also repurchased $176 million of its own stock (STRC), signaling management confidence

items.title: Corporate Treasuries Demonstrate Long-Term Conviction
points: Metaplanet sold 10,000 BTC then immediately repurchased 11,000 to prove it can raise cash on demand, addressing rating agency concerns, ending the quarter at 44,000 BTC
Bitmine extended its buying streak since June 2025 with $41 million in Ethereum purchases (15,112 ETH), reaching 99% of its goal to own 5% of Ethereum's circulating supply
Strive ramped up Bitcoin purchases to 2,000 BTC, up 81% week-over-week, indicating accelerating treasury accumulation

items.title: Bitcoin Technical Outlook and Market Conditions
points: Bitcoin traded at $85,314 on October 5 after surging to $86K on cooler inflation data and dovish Federal Reserve commentary, setting up a key week with October 14 CPI data
Prediction markets show 71% probability Bitcoin declines to $82,500 by October 31, 48% odds of retesting $80,000, but only 20% chance of dropping below $75,000
A second, stronger golden cross (a bullish technical signal where short-term moving averages cross above long-term ones) appeared on Bitcoin charts, suggesting structural support despite resistance

items.title: CFTC Unveils Plan to Bring Crypto Exchanges Under Federal Oversight
points: The CFTC (Commodity Futures Trading Commission, the US regulator for derivatives markets) proposed a framework to bring crypto exchanges under federal regulatory oversight

items.title: TD Cowen: Bitcoin's Institutional Era Has Arrived
points: TD Cowen, a financial services firm, declared that Bitcoin's institutional era has arrived, shifting the conversation from whether institutions will buy to how they will participate
This marks a turning point in mainstream financial sector perception, signaling growing acceptance of Bitcoin as a legitimate institutional asset class

issues.subject: 🚀 TD Cowen Says Bitcoin’s Institutional Era Has Arrived

headlines: TD Cowen declares Bitcoin's institutional era has arrived, shifting focus from whether large institutions will buy to how they will participate

sections.title: Institutional Adoption Milestone
points: 1. TD Cowen's assessment marks a significant turning point in mainstream financial sector perception of Bitcoin
2. The conversation has evolved from institutional skepticism about whether to invest to practical questions about participation methods and strategies
3. This shift signals growing acceptance and legitimacy of Bitcoin as an institutional asset class
